A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text and a white E in the black lower border, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-deathsquadron-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Squadron (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019): The game text reads: “Deploy on any system. Adds X to your total power at that system, where X = number of your starships present. Your troopers and combat vehicles may shuttle to related sites for free.”. The disc card had different words; the slip returns to the 2013 wording. This is a slip again: the lower part of the card with the white italic “E” in the black lower border; unlike the 2013 slip it prints no title.

The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
